records.title: TB Shrimp / The Brothers Shrimp
records.message:
🦐 **TB Shrimp / The Brothers Shrimp** (Asia (Vietnam reported; farm unverified))
**Strains / line associations:** Orange Bolts; Red Galaxy Fishbone Snowflakes; Red Fancy Tiger; Orange Metallic Boa; Red/Black Blizzard; Red/Black Snowfall; Orange-base Wasp
**Documented methods:** Generational selective grading for color/pattern and colony stability (distributor). Social breeder posts show deliberate next-generation Blizzard selection; exact crossing/pH not public.
**Competition record:** NAISC 2024: 1st Orange Bolts (Cat 8), 1st Red Galaxy Fishbone Snowflakes (Cat 9), 2nd Red Fancy Tiger (Cat 11), 3rd Orange Metallic Boa (Cat 13), 2nd Innovation (line unspecified).
**Sources:** https://rareshrimp.com/north-american-international-shrimp-competition-naisc-2024/ | https://shrimpcove.com/2-home
**Full dossier:** https://aquapedia.app/shrimpapedia/breeders/tb-shrimp-the-brothers-shrimp/ • Breeder Batch 002.
**Evidence:** source-backed-secondary. Maintained stocks ≠ original creation.

records.title: Galactic Shrimps / Marcin Stadnik
records.message:
🦐 **Galactic Shrimps / Marcin Stadnik** (Poland)
**Strains / line associations:** Red/Black Snowfall; Red Fancy Tiger; Pure Red Line GS Line 2; Galactic Red Stardust; OE Blue Bolt; Hornet; Red/Black Nanashi; Blue Boa; Metallic Blue Boa (seller catalog)
**Documented methods:** First-person breeding-room account: >100 tanks (~80L average); UGF with ADA Amazonia, notes improved stability in own system; does not establish superiority from a controlled trial.
**Competition record:** TGISC Dortmund 2023: brewer's retrospective credits Marcin 4 gold + 4 silver + 2 bronze; individual strain-to-medal matching still pending official score sheets. Also judged Italy 2023.
**Sources:** https://www.galacticshrimps.pl/en/ | https://www.galacticshrimps.pl/en/under-gravel-filtration-ugf-in-a-shrimp-tank-the-best-method-for-your-aquarium/ | https://www.galacticshrimps.pl/en/the-german-international-shrimp-contest-dortmund-2023/
**Full dossier:** https://aquapedia.app/shrimpapedia/breeders/galactic-shrimps-marcin-stadnik/ • Breeder Batch 002.
**Evidence:** first-party-self-reported. Maintained stocks ≠ original creation.
